environment: Owner Mac (macOS 25.6.0 arm64, node 26.8.2) reading an exclusively-owned PostgreSQL 16.15 database on loopback that holds a real live-production import. Production itself is untouched and was never opened for write.

commands.action: Reconcile the imported target against the source model
commands.command: node tools/v5-migration/cli.js verify --model <private live model> --run e2e-run --database-url postgresql://postgres@127.0.0.1:50709/v5_e2e --environment test

commands.action: A07 injected fault: exchange the two actors' coin balances, leaving the global total unchanged

result.evidence: each actor's economy.wallets.coins field hash is reported with the other actor's expected hash as the actual value, i.e. an exact cross-swap, plus a per-row committed-hash mismatch for both wallets

commands.action: Restore the two balances and re-reconcile

assertions: Per-actor currency reconciliation is exact for available, reserved, purchased and credit values; the live source's 150 and 157 coin wallets match, as do the 4 journal rows that explain them.

The A07 swapped-wallet fault is DETECTED even though the global total is provably unchanged (307 before and after): both actors are flagged, so an aggregate-only comparison would have produced a false success.
A restored target returns to zero unexplained differences, proving the detection is a real comparison and not a sticky failure.
Every one of the 5272 committed row hashes recomputes to its committed value, so no clean row is falsely reported as tampered.

The reserved-closure equation C2 holds (each actor's reserved equals the open match and room contributions), and the burn composition C3 holds without conflating the journal subset with the receipt-derived burn totals.
The conversion, tournament-pool, wealth, occupancy, relationship-symmetry and principal-referential equations C4-C9 all pass.

Differences are classified exactly once as match, explained(category,rule_id) or unexplained, using only the closed explained-category set; the six explained differences on the real source are two restore-normalization deltas, the two drained-outbox rows, one expired session and one rebuilt presence row.
A missing target row and an extra target row are each reported, and a single-column mutation is still reported, so the comparison detects absence, surplus and tampering.

not_claimed: G03 acceptance (the phase gate) or the Neon staging import
Semantic replay of a command through the V5 runtime path (P04/P08)
Production writes, production restore or cutover
sanitized_summary: Independent reconciliation of a real live-production import reports zero unexplained differences, with every committed row hash verified and all nine conservation equations passing. The A07 swapped-wallet fault is detected even when the global total is unchanged, and restoring the values returns the target to zero unexplained.
review_notes: The difference output carries locators, field paths and hashes only - no actor id, email address, credential value or raw row appears in it. Production was never opened for write; the fault injection was performed on an owned disposable database and reverted.
